description:
Bugatti Chiron Super Sport in London.

This hypercar is a true piece of art on wheels, from its shape to its paint and interiors, and let's not forget it's crazy 8.0 L W16 engine, which allows it to reach 420 km/h or 260 mph.

Its price is also astonishing, in between the £3 and £4 million. 

I was lucky enough to spot it in London today, and I hope you can enjoy it from your screen!

Sit back and enjoy.
